visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length dark hair wears a grey denim button-down shirt, standing in front of a large yellow promotional poster with bold Chinese characters for 'Butter Roasted Rice Cake'. He gestures animatedly with his hands while looking directly at the camera in a bright studio environment. (2) Close-up shots transition between three different brands of pastries: a plastic container from 85°C, a plastic bag from Wu Pao Chun, and a cardboard box from Sunmerry. The man's hands are seen lifting the clear plastic lid of the first container. (3) The man takes a bite of a brown, chestnut-shaped pastry, showing his facial expression of enjoyment. He then uses both hands to pull the pastry apart, revealing a stretchy, pale white mochi-like interior contrasting with the dark toasted exterior. (4) He picks up a pastry from the Wu Pao Chun brand bag and repeats the action, biting into it and then pulling the inner dough apart to show its texture. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy surface of the food. (5) The man holds a Sunmerry pastry and laughs, then breaks it open to show a thicker, crunchier-looking outer shell. (6) In the final segment, he holds pieces of the cakes in his hands, speaking enthusiastically with wide eye contact and large hand movements.
